title: In Progress® Telerik® Document Processing Libraries prior to version 2026.3.1027, uncontrolled recursion, inefficient…
description: A vulnerability in In Progress® Telerik® Document Processing Libraries prior to version 2026.3.1027 allows unauthenticated attackers to cause denial of service by triggering uncontrolled recursion, inefficient algorithmic complexity, or infinite loops in RadWordsProcessing when processing crafted DOCX, DOC, RTF, or HTML documents.
